forecast.disclaimer_algorithm: The forecast algorithm assigns higher grades to higher-credit courses first to maximize impact on your GPA. Credit breakdowns show which course weights each grade should apply to.
forecast.disclaimer_credits: Combinations are order-dependent: the grade assigned to a specific credit weight matters. Swapping grades between courses with different credits will change the resulting GPA.
forecast.disclaimer_algorithm_esp: ESP courses carry no credit hours, so the forecast algorithm assigns the best available grades across your remaining courses without weighting any of them more heavily than another.
forecast.disclaimer_credits_esp: Combinations are order-independent: since every ESP course counts equally toward your ESP GPA, only how many courses receive each grade matters, not which specific course it lands on.

about.title: About This Tool
about.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the GPA Calculator for Jala University

project.title: About the Project
project.description: An unofficial GPA calculator built by a Jala University student. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Jala University. All grades and settings are stored exclusively in your browser.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.p1: A what-if scenario tool for Software Engineering students to explore grade possibilities and understand their academic standing without entering course credits manually.
purpose.p2: Bridges Bolivia's 0–100 numeric grading system with Jala University's American-style 0–4.0 GPA scale, using pre-loaded course credits for every cohort.
purpose.p3: Serves as an information hub for academic honors, total credits, course completion, and graduation requirements.

grading.title: The Grading System
grading.intro: Jala University uses the American letter grade system. Numeric course scores (0–100) are converted to letter grades, which carry quality point values used in the GPA calculation.
grading.example: Example: a score of 92 in Programming I converts to A− = 3.7 quality points.
grading.failing_note: A grade of D− or lower is considered failing and requires repeating the course in all programs.

gpa_calc.title: GPA Calculation
gpa_calc.p1: Each course's quality points = letter grade value × course credit hours. Higher-credit courses carry proportionally more weight in your GPA.
gpa_calc.p1_esp: ESP courses carry no credit hours, so every course counts equally toward your ESP GPA — unlike the Software Engineering GPA, no course is weighted more heavily than another.
gpa_calc.p1_esp_note: Depending on your English level, some courses (often Labs) may not be assigned to you — that simply means you've already met that requirement, and it has no effect on your GPA.
gpa_calc.retakes_note: If you retake a failed course, the original attempt's grade still counts toward your cumulative GPA along with the new one — repeating a course doesn't erase it from your GPA history.
gpa_calc.p2: A minimum cumulative GPA of 2.0 is required to graduate from the Software Engineering program, in addition to completing the ESP English program.
gpa_calc.credits_note: This calculator pre-loads the correct credit values for every course in every cohort, so you never need to enter them manually.

honors.title: Academic Honors
honors.career_desc: Awarded based on your final cumulative GPA at the time of graduation.
honors.term_desc: Awarded for individual terms when all courses in that term have been graded.
honors.presidents_list: President's List — Term GPA = 4.00 (all A grades)
honors.deans_list: Dean's List — Term GPA between 3.50 and 3.99

cohorts.title: Cohort-Specific Programs
cohorts.description: Each cohort may have different courses or credit values due to program updates at Jala University. This calculator respects the academic program requirements in effect when each cohort enrolled, ensuring accurate and cohort-specific GPA results.

esp.title: ESP English Program
esp.description: ESP (English for Specific Purposes) has its own separate GPA, calculated as a simple average across all ESP courses since they carry no credit hours. The program is organized into Levels rather than terms, and while completing it is mandatory for graduation, it doesn't affect your Software Engineering GPA (some Labs may not be assigned to you, depending on your English level).

privacy.title: Privacy & Data
privacy.description: No personal data is ever sent to a server or stored in any database. All grades and settings are stored exclusively in your browser's localStorage. Clearing your browser data will remove your saved grades. Your information never leaves your device.

acknowledgments.title: Acknowledgments
acknowledgments.description: Special thanks to Jala University's Student Services & Registrar team for providing accurate information and patiently resolving questions about GPA calculation methodology at the university, and to the [beta testers](https://github.com/Fernando-Pinto-Villarroel/gpa-calculator/blob/main/README.md#beta-testers) for testing the app and ensuring reliability and correctness for their specific cohorts and suggesting new features and improvements.

tour.welcome_title: Welcome to the GPA Calculator for Jala University
tour.welcome_content: This quick tour will guide you through all the features. You can skip at any time.
tour.navbar_brand_content: Click the logo to return to the Dashboard at any time.
tour.navbar_links_content: Use these links to navigate between Dashboard, Grades, Statistics, Forecast, and About pages.
tour.navbar_career_content: Switch between your enrolled programs, like your degree and the ESP certificate. Every page adapts to show the data for the selected program. More programs will be added here over time.
tour.navbar_language_content: Switch the app language between English, Spanish, and Portuguese.
tour.navbar_theme_content: Toggle between light and dark mode.
tour.dashboard_gpa_content: This is your overall GPA, calculated from all the grades you have entered across all terms.
tour.dashboard_honor_content: This badge shows your current honor status: Cum Laude (≥3.20), Magna (≥3.50), Summa (≥3.80). Between 2.00 and 2.50 means Academic Risk. Below 2.00 means SAP Risk — Satisfactory Academic Progress risk, which triggers closer follow-up from the institution.
tour.dashboard_stats_content: Key metrics at a glance: subjects completed, best and lowest grades, earned credits, remaining credits, terms completed, and Dean's and President's List term counts.
tour.config_toolbar_content: This is where you enter all your grades. Use the toolbar to select your cohort and term, and use Import/Export to back up your data.
tour.config_cohort_content: Choose the cohort that matches when you enrolled. Each cohort has its own course list and credit values pre-loaded — you never need to enter credits manually.
tour.config_term_content: Navigate between academic terms. Grades are stored per term and cohort independently.
tour.config_course_card_content: Each card represents a course in the selected term. Click the grade dropdown on the right to select your letter grade (A, B+, C, etc.).
tour.esp_config_toolbar_content: This is where you enter your ESP grades. Use the toolbar to select your cohort, and use Import/Export to back up your data.
tour.esp_config_cohort_content: Choose the cohort that matches when you enrolled in the ESP program. Unlike other careers, ESP has no terms — courses are grouped into three fixed Levels shown side by side.
tour.esp_config_course_card_content: Each card represents an ESP course or lab within its Level. Click the grade dropdown on the right to select your letter grade (A, B+, C, etc.). Depending on your English level, some courses (often Labs) may not be assigned to you — that's expected and won't affect your GPA.
tour.esp_config_credits_content: ESP courses normally carry no credit hours, so this badge should always be 0 — every course counts equally toward your ESP GPA.
tour.config_credits_content: Shows the pre-loaded credit hours for this course. In rare cases — if you took the course when its credits were different — double-click this badge to override the value.
tour.config_retake_content: If you failed and retook a course, click the warning icon to register each attempt with its own grade and credits. All attempts count toward your GPA calculation, but only the approved attempt counts for statistics like remaining credits and completed subjects.
tour.config_action_import_content: Restore your grades from a previously exported JSON backup file.
tour.config_action_export_content: Save your current cohort's grades as a JSON backup file you can import later or on another device.
tour.config_pdf_upload_content: Upload your Report Card PDF directly from Jala University's SIS. Go to the SIS website, navigate to Consolidated > Report Cards, press Ctrl+Shift+P to save the page as PDF, then upload it here. Your courses and grades will be automatically recognized and imported.
tour.config_action_reset_content: Clear grades for the current term or the entire cohort. This cannot be undone.
tour.playground_welcome_content: This sandbox mirrors Canvas's grade summary so you can simulate a course's weighting and assignments, independent from your official grades.
tour.playground_back_content: Use this link anytime to return to your Grades page.
tour.playground_title_content: Double-click the title to rename this playground course.
tour.playground_add_assignment_content: Create a new assignment. It appears at the top of the list.
tour.playground_assignment_content: Double-click the name to rename an assignment.
tour.playground_drag_content: Click and drag this handle to reorder assignments in the list.
tour.playground_group_select_content: Assign this assignment to one of your weight groups (e.g. Quizzes, Labs).
tour.playground_score_content: Click to enter the score and maximum points for this assignment.
tour.playground_delete_assignment_content: Delete this assignment from the list.
tour.playground_total_content: Your simulated course grade, calculated from graded assignments and their weight groups.
tour.playground_groups_table_content: Edit each group's name and weight percentage, or remove a group entirely.
tour.playground_groups_actions_content: Add a new weight group, or reset all groups back to the default template.
tour.playground_actions_menu_content: Backup, restore, import from Canvas, or reset this playground from here.
tour.playground_action_import_backup_content: Load a previously exported playground JSON file.
tour.playground_action_export_backup_content: Save this playground's current state to a JSON file you can re-import later.
tour.playground_action_import_canvas_content: Upload a Canvas "Print Grades" PDF and this playground will auto-fill your course title, weight groups, and assignments.
tour.playground_action_reset_content: Restore the default 7-week assignment template. This cannot be undone.
tour.statistics_overview_content: A summary of your academic performance: current GPA, total credits earned, course completion percentage, projected honor status, and Dean's/President's List terms.
tour.statistics_charts_content: Visual charts showing your GPA progression over time, term-by-term GPA, grade distribution frequency, and credit accumulation per term.
tour.forecast_scope_content: Choose whether to forecast your Term GPA (for a single term) or Cumulative GPA (overall). Term mode also lets you select which term to target.
tour.forecast_target_content: Enter the GPA you want to achieve, or click one of the honor preset buttons (Cum Laude, Magna, Summa for cumulative; Dean's List, President's List for term).
tour.forecast_scenarios_content: See what your GPA would be if all remaining courses in scope received the same grade. A quick way to assess best/worst case outcomes.
tour.forecast_combinations_content: Finds the optimal grade distributions that would allow you to reach your target GPA. Each combination shows the credit breakdown so you know which course weights to target for each grade.
tour.forecast_config_content: Configure which grades to consider and how many result combinations to show. Expanding or narrowing the grade selection directly affects which combinations are possible.
tour.done_content: You now know how to use the GPA Calculator for Jala University. Start by selecting your cohort in the Grades page and entering your grades. Good luck!
